<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 192.103 Da. The formula that best matches this mass within typical mass‑spectrometer accuracy is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.1150 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ of 193.1223 Da, within ~10 ppm of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula is C12H16O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
